DwoodAmo · docs/diagrams

Dialectic — system architecture

Two humans and an LLM co-reason in real time; the LLM is a participant, not an assistant. This map was drawn from the running code rather than the docs — and in the process the docs turned out to be wrong in five places. Two further suspicions did not survive checking, and are recorded below as confirmed rather than quietly dropped.

  • dialectic.service :8002
  • tradingdesk.service :8006
  • defuddle.service :8010

The map

Colour encodes role, not layer: purple is the LLM participant, amber is the clock, orange is anything that speaks HTTP to another process, green is a datastore, dashed grey is external or not running. Scroll the frame to pan; the buttons scale it.

Drift — CLAUDE.md against the tree

Each of these was found while sourcing a label for the diagram, and each is verified at a call site rather than inferred from a filename. The diagram shows the code's version.

  • DriftThe tool registry is 15 tools, not 12

    CLAUDE.md: “llm/tool_loop.py over a 12-tool registry”

    Eight tradingDesk tools plus seven dialectic tools, all registered unconditionally — there is no per-room gating despite the builder's docstring claiming it.

    dialectic/tests/test_tools_registry.py:70 — asserts len(registry.tools) == 15

  • DriftNine scheduled jobs, not four

    CLAUDE.md names: trading reconcile/watchdog, morning brief, silence sweep

    Also live and undocumented: thesis_news_digest (05:30 CT), wire_watch (900 s), prediction_deadline_watch (3600 s), reading_echo (1800 s), and scheduler_heartbeat (600 s). Each has its own enable flag.

    dialectic/api/main.py:254-265 — registration block in the lifespan

  • Stale filedeploy/dialectic.service describes a deploy that does not exist

    The repo's unit file points at /opt/dialectic/current/dialectic with a release-symlink scheme. That directory is absent on this host, and the unit systemd actually loads runs the working tree via python3 run.py. CLAUDE.md's house rule — “both systemd units run their git working trees” — is the accurate one; the checked-in service file is the trap.

    live: /etc/systemd/system/dialectic.service — WorkingDirectory=/root/DwoodAmo/dialectic

  • DriftA third service is undocumented

    defuddle.service runs a Node article extractor on :8010 and backs the read_article tool. It is active right now and appears in no CLAUDE.md table.

    dialectic/deploy/defuddle.service · llm/defuddle_client.py

  • DriftMigrations run to 016, not 013

    CLAUDE.md calls 013 current. 014 adds the reading library (whose reading_items table is therefore missing from the schema.sql baseline), and 016 is the embedding-width change above.

    dialectic/migrations/ — 001 … 016

Confirmed — claims that held up

Worth recording, because several are the kind of detail that usually has rotted — and because the last two started out on the drift list and were taken off it.

  • RetractedThe embedding dimension was already documented correctly

    This began as a drift finding — an automated pass reported the docs claiming 1536-dim OpenAI against a live 1024-wide column. The docs say no such thing: dialectic/CLAUDE.md:145 reads “pgvector, 1024-dim Voyage voyage-4-large; OpenAI 1536 remains the fallback provider when VOYAGE_API_KEY is unset”, and adds that switching provider needs a column migration and a full re-embed because the two live in different vector spaces. That is more precise than the correction would have been.

    live DB: memories.embedding typmod = 1024 — matches the doc, not the report

  • RetractedtradingDesk's port 8000 is the dev convention, not an error

    Also started as drift — the Makefile runs uvicorn on 8000 while production is 8006. But dialectic/CLAUDE.md:10 reserves 8000 for exactly this (“port 8002 — port 8000 is reserved”), so the split is deliberate. The only real inconsistency is that trading/README.md:14 shows 8006 for the dev command. Left alone: the Makefile is right, and rewriting it would break the convention.

    trading/Makefile:10 (dev) · deploy/tradingdesk.service (prod, 8006)

  • ConfirmedPush on change + hourly heartbeat is exact

    _should_push_dialectic returns true when the tick produced events, otherwise when 3600 s have elapsed since the last delivered push — a spooled failure deliberately leaves the heartbeat due so the next tick retries.

    trading/web/runtime/coordinator.py:660 — DIALECTIC_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS = 3600.0

  • Confirmedcc-sidecar is lineage, not runtime

    Nothing in dialectic/ or trading/ imports it and no unit runs it — only comments cite it as the ancestor of the participation FSM and the silence sweep. It is drawn unconnected on purpose; an edge would imply a runtime coupling that does not exist.

    grep across both projects — zero imports, zero HTTP calls, zero unit references

  • ConfirmedThe symlink flip is the frontend release

    /var/www/dialectic-current currently points at dialectic-releases/20260813T055358Z-release-1-workroom, flipped today at 00:53 — the Release 1 Workroom build.

    readlink -f /var/www/dialectic-current

  • ConfirmedThe tradingDesk SQLite path resolves as documented

    The code default web/data/tradingdesk.db is a symlink to /var/lib/tradingdesk/tradingdesk.db (59 MB, written today), so both the README and the connection module are describing the same file. room-tokens.env sits beside it at 0600, outside the git tree — which is why registering a room token needs no restart.

    trading/web/persistence/connection.py:15 · tools/bridge/room_tokens.py:54
